instruction: I find the background cone animation in VLC Media Player distracting when no media is playing. Could you help me disable the background cone so the player shows a plain background instead?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone animation in VLC. The evaluator checks the qt-bgcone setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 0 (disabled). Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric function.
metadata.verification: Checked existing VLC metric functions. check_qt_bgcone reads vlcrc file and verifies qt-bgcone=0. Default is 1 (enabled), so task requires changing it to 0.
